answer: Submitting an answer locks 31 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The river escrow is released only against a umber receipt, and the willow audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 170 aliases means carrying 151 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
